proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow behavior: `build-artifactory-ppu.yml` is reworked to produce/upload one Actions artifact per package, add per-package transfer-back calls/properties, adjust schedule/push triggering and summary reporting, and the three workflow build scripts are updated to match packaging layout plus runner-side dependency/install robustness. These are test/build pipeline orchestration changes, not review-policy (`workflow`) or core compiler/build-definition (`build`) ownership.
